subject: Bridge request: competing offer + band clarification for Vikram Rao
messages:
From: Sasha Patel <sasha@talentbridge.co>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Vikram Rao - verbal competing offer, needs quick decision

Hi Connor / Jonas,

Quick update on Vikram Rao (Data Platform Lead candidate). He just accepted a verbal offer from a larger FAANG-style firm: $280k base, 35k sign, and an accelerated equity tranche. They gave him a 72-hour window to sign. Vikram is still very interested in Redwood and asked whether there is flexibility on base or an immediate signing bridge so he can buy time for the internal approval process.

I attached a short summary of the competing package and the original Redwood offer we discussed last week. Vikram indicated the base number is the primary driver but the sign-on helps shorten the gap. He asked specifically: can Redwood match base or offer a short-term bridge (one-time cash) + an equity refresh conversation after 6 months?

Candidate is respectful of confidentiality and wants a fast yes/no so he can consider his options. Recommended next step: internal quick alignment on whether we can offer a one-time bridge (signing bonus) and whether we can expedite any band exception for base.

Attachments: 2028-06-20_Vikram_Offer.pdf

Thanks,
Sasha
TalentBridge
(she/they)
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vikram Rao - verbal competing offer, needs quick decision

Jonas / Grace — forwarding Sasha's note. Vikram is one of our top picks for the infra/data lane; his system design and exec communication fit the role. Hiring timeline: we were aiming for a start in August.

Immediate asks: can we (1) approve a one-time bridge signing bonus to secure time while we get final band approval, and (2) consider a short-term band exception to raise base to $260k with a plan for a mid-year equity refresh? If we can't match base, bridge + faster equity review may close the gap.

I have the candidate's written preference (attached) and the current comp proposal. Please advise if I should (a) give Vikram an extension to decide, (b) offer a bridge now, or (c) escalate to finance/comp for an emergency band exception.

Connor
Director, Data Platform Recruiting
Redwood Inference
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Vikram Rao - verbal competing offer, needs quick decision

Connor — thanks for the heads up. I reviewed Vikram's loop feedback and the comp impact. Quick thoughts:

- Base band: current band caps at 240k for the role; pushing to 260k is a band exception and not standard.
- Signing bridge: we can approve a one-time bridge up to 20k from our candidate experience pool with Director sign-off; larger needs finance sign-off.
- Equity refresh: plausible after 6 months if performance and business needs align, but not guaranteed.

If we want to be competitive without breaking band policy, a 20k signing bridge + clear path to equity review at 6 months may be our fastest route. If Connor wants to pursue 260k base, I need a short justification and headcount owner sign-off; that will take ~48 business hours to route.

Recommend: offer 20k bridge + ask candidate for a 48-hour extension so we can complete approvals. If candidate refuses, escalate to Markus for emergency exception.

Jonas
VP, Product Infrastructure
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Vikram Rao <vikram.rao@gmail.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood offer + short extension request

Hi Vikram — thanks for being candid on the competing offer and timelines. We're excited about the prospect of you joining the Data Platform team. Quick update: internally we can move immediately to approve a one-time signing bridge of $20,000 to give you breathing room. We can also commit to a formal equity refresh discussion at the 6-month mark where we will revisit grant sizing based on performance and milestones.

Could you do a 48-hour extension on the deadline so we can (a) get final director sign-off confirmed, and (b) explore whether a band exception is feasible? If yes, I will respond with a consolidated offer update within that window.

If you prefer an immediate, written offer with the bridge included, let me know and I will share an updated offer packet tonight.

Best,
Connor
From: Vikram Rao <vikram.rao@gmail.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-20T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood offer + short extension request

Connor — thank you for the quick follow. I appreciate the bridge proposal and the 6-month equity conversation. I will take the 48-hour extension but would prefer an official written offer that includes the $20k bridge so I can show it to the other recruiter. If you can send the updated offer tonight, that will help.

I do want to be transparent: if another firm increases base significantly in that window I may have to make a decision, but the bridge + clear roadmap makes Redwood my top choice.

— Vikram
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-21T18:04:00-07:00
Subject: Approved: one-time bridge and expedited band review (limited)

Connor — following up after quick finance sync. Approved: one-time signing bridge of $20,000 (gross, paid at start date) to be included in the written offer. We will also open an expedited band review for this hiring manager to consider a base increase up to $260k, contingent on headcount budget reallocation. The band review is "expedited" but requires the hiring manager to document business justification and expected impact; target decision is within 48 business hours but not guaranteed.

Please proceed to send the updated offer (attach bridge language and signatory), copy HR compensation, and include the HIRE-219 Jira link for audit. Markus
Finance (talent approvals)
